Ava (AE): Heads-up — MedicaGen escalated to their execs. They want a one-pager: estimated lead time and cost delta for Private VPC + reserved Dedicated GPUs vs hosted, plus SOC2 evidence and a filled security questionnaire by COB Thu. Can we pull this together?
Raj (SE): Clarifying: Private = Redwood Private with VPC peering + Dedicated pool, correct? Or asking for an air-gapped option?
Dr. Chen (Customer CISO): Redwood Private (VPC peering) is fine. Requirements: customer-managed KMS, network allowlist, proof-of-delete for inference logs, and SOC2 Type II. Need answers in the SQ for sections 2/3.
Ben (SRE): We support KMS BYO (AWS/GCP). Typical KMS validation + key policy review = 48h after we get ARN and IAM role. Dedicated capacity provisioning can be expedited to ~7 business days with approvals; standard 14 days.
Marta (Sales Ops): Quick pricing note: committed 12mo Dedicated pool (4x A100 equiv) + VPC peering + onboarding PS fee. I'll run 3 scenarios (no discount, 12% discount, 18% discount) and a monthly delta vs hosted. Need target discount band.
Ava (AE): Customer asked for 18% on 12mo. I can approve up to 12% from AE budget. Anything above needs director OK.
Nora (Finance): 18% needs approval; also require an estimated utilization curve to validate unit economics. If they commit to minimum throughput we can consider a deeper concession.
Lisa (Legal): I'll need the exact deletion SLA they want (hours) to draft an addendum. Also we can provide redacted SOC2 Type II and pen-test exec summary. Please upload the SQ.
Ava (AE): Uploading SQ now: https://files.redwood/medicagen-sq-may2025.pdf. Dr. Chen, can you confirm deletion window acceptable?
Dr. Chen (Customer CISO): Prefer 48h for inference logs; must be encrypted with customer keys and contractually guaranteed with proof-of-delete steps. 24h preferred but not mandatory.
Ben (SRE): 48h doable with current infra and a documented proof-of-delete playbook; 24h would require changes to log pipeline (~+10 days).
Raj (SE): Blockers from SE side: staging fqdn for TLS validation, MediGen netops contact for peering, and sample ingress CIDR. Once we have that, VPC peering tests are 24-72h.
Marta (Sales Ops): Action: I'll produce the pricing delta + PS fee options in 3 hours. Will include required approval path for >12% discount.
Lisa (Legal): Action: Draft DPA + Private Addendum with KMS BYO clause and 48h deletion SLA. ETA EOD today.
Ben (SRE): Action: I'll DM KMS key policy template and a redacted proof-of-delete playbook. ETA 5h.
Raj (SE): Action: I'll produce a 1-page network diagram + firewall snippet for their netops. ETA 6h.
Ava (AE): One-line blockers for the exec one-pager I need for their CTO:
- Raj: need MediGen netops contact + staging FQDN (blocker)
- Ben: need KMS ARN + IAM role to validate (blocker)
- Marta/Nora: need target discount band to finalize pricing (blocker)
- Lisa: need final deletion SLA number from customer (blocker)
Ava (AE): I'll push for netops contact in the call this afternoon. If anyone hits issues, @here. :pray: 
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of VPC peering templates scheduled 04:00 UTC (no customer impact).
